Hamarcolet

HAMARCOLET is a branding project for a neighborhood grocery store. The visual identity combines a nostalgic feeling with a clean and modern design, creating a warm and familiar experience. Inspired by traditional local grocery stores, the brand aims to bring back a sense of community and connection through a simple and approachable visual language.

Grocery store branding project
